title: Maps and geography stories vs space and astronomy stories on hits
question: Does a story about maps and geography reach ten points more often than a story about space and astronomy?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about maps and geography reaches ten points more often than a story about space and astronomy.
expect: If true, share of stories that reach ten points for maps and geography stories should be at least 1.5x the value for space and astronomy stories, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: share of stories that reach ten points, maps and geography against space and astronomy

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h370, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h350 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a theme is not proof the story is about it, and one story can sit in both groups.
Both groups are title words only, so stories that never name the theme are missed.
h350 asked a different question; this card compares two groups head to head.
